title: AO/69/2009 of TAMILNADU TRANSPORT CORPORATION Vs ANILKUMAR BISHNOI and OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
 Appeal from Order No. 69/2009
 (Under Section 173 of the M.V. Act, 1988)

Tamilnadu Transport Corporation .... Appellant
Versus
Anil Kumar Bishnoi & Ors. Ö Respondents
Mr. Ashish Joshi, Adv. for the appellant.
Mr. Neeraj Garg, Adv. for the respondents.
 24th July, 2014
Honíble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
 Tamilnadu Transport Corporation (appellant) has
challenged the judgment and order dated 01.10.2007 passed
by the Tribunal, awarding Rs.6,00,200/- as compensation to
the respondents/claimants, who are the parents of a young
boy. The youth was pursuing second year of engineering
course in Tamilnadu where the bus of Tamilnadu Transport
Corporation struck the victim and he succumbed to the
injuries caused by that accident.
Primary ground in this appeal is the amount of
compensation, which has been awarded. It has been argued by
learned counsel that considering the age of the deceased it
was not proper for the Tribunal to award such an exorbitant
compensation.
I have gone through the impugned judgment and also
heard the learned counsel for both the parties. I find that since
the deceased, a youth running in the prime of his life, was
pursuing his engineering career and was the only son of the
respondents/claimants having borrowed the education loan
worth Rs.5.00 lakh, out of which he had already consumed
Rs.2.00 lakh in his education.
So, looking to these aspects, the amount of
compensation, so awarded by the Tribunal, is not exorbitant

2
at all. This appeal is bereft of any merit and is dismissed as
such.
Rest of the amount, which has been deposited by the
Corporation before the Tribunal shall be withdrawn by the
respondents/claimants and they shall also be entitled to move
an application for recovery of the amount of interest, which
incurred on the principal amount and the remaining sum, if
not deposited by the Corporation in the Tribunal. Interim
orders dated 29.07.2009 and 06.08.2010 are vacated
accordingly.
